title: An interrupt between the creation of a landing ticket and the assignment of its name leaves the ticket in the queue, and the landing lock's SIGTERM handler is not restored
goal: landing_lock removes a ticket it created on any interrupt, also one that lands between os.open and the assignment of the ticket name, and restores the SIGTERM handler it replaced

run:
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_close
t = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", t], check=True)
qdir = bl_close.landing_queue_dir(bl_close.landing_lock_path(t))
real = os.fdopen
def boom(*a, **k):
    os.fdopen = real
    raise KeyboardInterrupt
os.fdopen = boom  # an interrupt lands between the creation of the ticket and the assignment of its name
try:
    with bl_close.landing_lock(t, "ST-aaaaaaaa"):
        pass
except BaseException as e:
    print("interrupted by", type(e).__name__)
finally:
    os.fdopen = real
left = os.listdir(qdir) if qdir.is_dir() else []
print("tickets left in the queue:", left)
sys.exit(0 if not left else 1)
